title: confiture migrate reinit --format json
description: Result of clearing the tracking table and re-marking the migration files as applied (MigrateReinitResult.to_dict). A failure writes the error envelope (error-envelope.schema.json) instead of this shape.

marked.description: Migrations re-marked as applied, oldest → newest; in --dry-run, those that would be.

total_duration_ms.description: Wall-clock time of the operation, in milliseconds.

warnings.description: Non-fatal warning messages; empty if none.

error.description: Always null in this shape: a command that fails writes the error envelope (error-envelope.schema.json) instead.

ok.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command produced this report. A command that could not produce one writes the error envelope, where ok is false.

command.description: The envelope (1.16.0): the command that wrote this payload, as typed after `confiture`.
